summary: Frontend-only test for client-side Full DB Backup export/restore wiring in /settings/backup-center. Verified export flow reads custom paginated headers (X-Has-More/X-Next-After/X-Count), assembles ZIP with JSZip and shows success toast. Also verified restore confirm dialog opens with checklist and Cancel closes it (non-destructive).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warnings in console: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' — likely in a header/notification component. Not related to Backup Center but pollutes console noise on every page.

test_scenarios_executed.name: Export Base Completa client-side
test_scenarios_executed.details: 84 GET requests to /api/admin/full-backup/collection (all 200). 81 responses exposed custom headers X-Has-More/X-Count/X-Next-After to the frontend. Progress transitioned through 'Descargando colecciones…' -> 'Comprimiendo ZIP…' and finished in ~46s with toast 'Respaldo total ensamblado y descargado correctamente'. Multi-page pagination was exercised on inbox_messages (7 pages) and user_sessions (2 pages) and the loop terminated correctly (X-Has-More=0 on last page). No JS console errors emitted during the export process.

test_scenarios_executed.name: Custom header readability from browser (CORS Access-Control-Expose-Headers)
test_scenarios_executed.details: response.headers['x-has-more'] readable in browser context confirmed by loop advancing across pages and X-Count values matching document counts. If headers had not been exposed, pagination would have stalled.

test_scenarios_executed.name: Restore dialog opens and Cancel closes (non-destructive)
test_scenarios_executed.details: Clicking 'Restaurar Base Completa…' opens native file picker; selecting a minimal zip with _manifest.json opens data-testid='full-backup-confirm-dialog' with checklist row 'clients 642 → 10'. Clicking 'Cancelar' (data-testid='full-backup-cancel-btn') closes the dialog. No restore executed.

action_items: (Optional, out-of-scope from this test) Fix pre-existing React hydration warnings ('<tr> as child of <span>' / '<span> as child of <tbody>') that appear on every page load. They are unrelated to Backup Center but visible in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Client-side export flow in BackupCenter.jsx works end-to-end and correctly handles paginated collections via X-Has-More/X-Next-After headers.

Backend endpoint responds with the custom headers exposed to the browser (Access-Control-Expose-Headers likely configured), otherwise frontend loop could not progress across pages — verified empirically.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/zt/mini.zip (minimal backup ZIP with _manifest.json referencing clients collection) for restore dialog test — not used to actually restore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client-side Full DB Backup export is confirmed working in the browser: JSZip assembly + custom paginated headers read correctly + success toast + no console errors from the feature. Restore dialog opens and cancels cleanly. Destructive restore was NOT executed (as requested).
